 PORN WARS II: Kendra Lust Mocked Her Mortal Enemy Lisa Ann By Posing With Matt Rife At His Standup Show And Also Teased More Drama About Lisa Hooking Up With Yung Gravy
 Devlin 11/17/2026 7:00 PM Facebook Icon 7 Folks our favorite stepmoms are STILL fighting online and the digital drama juices are gushing all over the place. Tough scenes all around. Just an absolute mess that even Johnny Sins would avoid at this point. 
 And although I made it clear in the blog above I'm firmly #TeamLisa, I'll try my best to be unbiased in this one. If you need to catch up to speed on all this PORN WAR chaos, give a click above. Long story short, back in 2024 Lisa Ann got thrown out of a Matt Rife comedy show and thrown into handcuffs over allegedly disrupting the audience by using her phone. Despite getting cleared of all charges, Matt now uses this clip to kick things off for all his standup crowds. What a jerk!
 Lisa recently addressed this nonsense in a podcast last week and that lead to all these gaping wounds being reopened for the hole world to see. Along with Matt getting his favorite porn star Kendra Lust to jump in the mix too. Apparently there is NO love lost between her & Lisa. Genuine hate both on a professional and personal scale. 
 Advertisement
 You know it's getting serious when '8-Mile' AI edits are getting thrown around town. You'll have to click the blog at the top if you wanna know all the sordid details on the nitty gritty of their tweets, but point is Kendra is firmly #TeamRife. 
 And Lisa thinks he's only carrying on that clip stunt in order to gain favor & fuck his favorite porn star, Ms. Lust. Oh what tangled webs of cum we weave indeed! Speaking of which, here's both of them for reference if you're somehow unfamiliar.

 And even though Ms. Ann delivered an uppercut HAYMAKER with her final tweet declaring Rife a #CUCK last week, it seems the lust within Kendra's soul knows no bounds. She didn't hear no bell other than The Fuckin' Bell, and so she has continued their rivalry into today. Not only gleefully posting an intimate recent pose with Matt Rife, but also bringing up some dirty baggage about Lisa & singer Yung Gravy too? Oh the humanity!

 My silence gave you confidence. That was your first mistake.  I let you tell your version. Don’t get mad when I tell mine. Just keeping @mattrife relevant 🤣  
 Advertisement
 Now apparently Lisa hooked up with Mr. Gravy years ago but later became so disgusted with him she completely ghosted his ass? Look I have NO fuckin' idea what's going on here, we're all learning this together okay? Thankfully in this case, we DO have an in-house answer on this one. Salute to our finest ma'am Pat from 'Out & About' for that. 
 Asked Lisa Ann whether Yung Gravy actually lived up to the hype. She didn’t hesitate. “Fuck yeah.”  Lisa then recalled a particularly memorable encounter involving her kitchen counter, joking that her back was bruised for an entire week. But according to her, it was completely worth it. She said the experience exceeded her expectations so much that it became a topic of conversation in multiple group chats with her girlfriends. Then she explained the difference between a genuinely great experience and the kind of disappointing review women might send their friends. Mimicking a hypothetical BAD review, she joked: “His vibe is so amazing… but for not the good reason. He came so quick, LOL, get me out of here.”  To be clear, she wasn’t describing Gravy with that last comment. She was explaining why her actual review of him was the complete opposite. Yung Gravy apparently earned himself a five-star review AND a permanent spot in the group chat.  
 Advertisement
 During an interview with Out & About, Lisa opened up about her experience with the rapper. She admitted the sex was good and even considered seeing him again. But things changed when they went to Las Vegas for the AVN Awards. Gravy was supposed to be her date, but Lisa says she couldn't stand being around him anymore. She felt he'd gotten too caught up in the adult industry scene, describing him as "grimy." She eventually decided to stand him up. And when it came to giving him another chance, Lisa made her feelings pretty clear. She didn't need "just another piece of dick." 
 But that was YEARS ago. As it stands today, Mr. Gravy has clearly moved on with OnlyFans star Ari Kytsya. They seem to be happy as a shaved clam together. Choose LOVE .

 Hopefully ALL parties involved can find that same level of maturity ASAP. Of course I wouldn't expect that from Matt Rife since he's a genuine card carrying loser of this earth, but I do have some hope for Kendra turning things around. 
 After all, MILFs are supposed to be cheeky & fun. Let's get back to that vibe instead. Either way, it's comforting to know Lisa seems to be doing just fine with it all. 
 And THAT is why it's #TeamLisa every damn day until the Sun explodes, thus fading us & every memory of this ordeal into Bolivian. Oh what a glorious day that will be. Stay safe out there.
